provider_slug.description:
Financial provider slug

*Can be consulted at the v2/financial/providers endpoint.

environment.description:
Connection environment with the financial provider.

`production`: Production.
`homologation`: Homologation

* For security reasons, this field will be ignored in our Sandbox environment.

apis.description:
APIs enabled for the financial provider.

`charge/bank_billet`: boleto.
`charge/pix`: Pix.
`payment`: Payment.
`transfer`: Transfer

credentials.description: Credentials used in authentication and authorization with the provider.

associations.description:
Associated service accounts.

`charge.bank_billet_account`: boleto Wallet.
`charge.pix_account`: Pix Account.
`payment.account`: Payment Account.
`transfer.account`: Transfer Account.
`statement.account`: Statement Account

*Note about `charge.pix_account`*: by default Pix key validation at the PSP is synchronous — failures return `422`. On some accounts validation occurs in the background; in that case `201` response is returned before validation completes — follow the result via `validated_at` and `enabled_at` in the PixAccount.

*Note about `payment.account` and `transfer.account`*: validation with the provider is synchronous — the association is already done when `201` response returns, and failures return `422` with the provider's message.
